{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure freshness
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for duplicate order_id entries
duplicate_orders = sales_df['order_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f"Number of duplicate order_id entries: {duplicate_orders}")

# Check for missing order_id entries (i.e., nulls)
missing_order_ids = sales_df['order_id'].isna().sum()
print(f"Number of missing order_id entries: {missing_order_ids}")"}
